messages:
emma_sales: Hey team — Zenith Health just sent over a SIG/CAIQ (attached). They want answers + our encryption matrix by EOW if possible. Can someone take ownership? 

raj_se: I can help with tech Qs and the encryption matrix. Is this for hosted API or private deployment?

mia_security: Throwing a quick triage on this — need scope + whether PHI/PII is in scope. If PHI, turnaround is usually longer (legal + SOC review).

emma_sales: It's for a hosted integration (no on-prem). They will send PII (patient identifiers) in tokens, so yes PHI-adjacent. Customer is an enterprise close to final contract — high priority. Attached filename: `Zenith_SIG_v14.pdf`. Link: https://redwood.share/Zenith/Zenith_SIG_v14.pdf

sec-automation-bot: Ticket created: SR-2738 assigned to security-triage. SLA: 72 hours. https://redwood.support/SR-2738

jordan_pss: FYI: sales asked for a short summary we can send to their InfoSec (one-pager + completed CAIQ). Also need confirmation on KMS + region.

mia_security: Assigning to me. I'll do CAIQ answers and the encryption matrix. Requesting the contract redline and dataflow diagram from sales to ensure scope. ETA 48-72 hrs given PHI note.

raj_se: For encryption: we use AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit, per-customer KMS support in Dedicated/Private. For hosted, we offer regional key options with BYOK via KMS integrations — I'll draft the exact copy.

emma_sales: Thanks. Quick Q: do we have any extra attestation (SOC2) docs we can attach right now?

mia_security: Yes — SOC2 Type II summary + ISO27001 statement are in the security doc repo. I'll attach and link in the CAIQ responses.

emma_sales: Great. Customer also asked: can we sign a standard vendor DPA? They mentioned a security questionnaire clause for subprocessors.

mia_security: We have a standard DPA template. Legal needs to sign off for any extra subprocessor commitments, but standard is OK for now. I'll flag Legal if they request changes.

raj_se: Also note: POC is scheduled next Tue — we should avoid heavy blocking items before that. If any control is missing, we should propose compensating controls for the POC.

mia_security: Yup. I'll mark open questions in SR-2738 and add a short mitigation plan for the POC.

emma_sales: Perfect. Assigning follow-ups: `mia_security` to complete CAIQ + attachments, `raj_se` to prepare encryption and network answers, `jordan_pss` to provide dataflow & contract snippet. Please update SR-2738 once you upload. :thumbsup:

sec-automation-bot: SR-2738 updated: owner=mia_security, due=1769264034 (72h). Notifications sent to: @emma_sales @raj_se @jordan_pss

mia_security: Starting now. Will post the completed CAIQ PDF into the ticket and drop a 1-page summary for sales.

raj_se: Drafting encryption/network blurb — will paste into the ticket in ~2 hours.

emma_sales: Thanks team. If anything looks like it will delay the close, ping me — this is a quarter-end deal.

mia_security: Understood. If legal needs to review DPA changes, we'll escalate.

emma_sales: Closing loop for now — will monitor SR-2738. :sparkles:
